tweets.quoted_tweet_text:
*IMPORTANT* 

!!! please read !!!

now that Synth Waves are out, we’re ready to begin taking claims for Argonaut prints!

yungwknd rebuilt the claim portal to make the process easier for everyone. the updated portal collects some required information that the previous version didn’t, so all previous claims have been reset. if you submitted a claim before, you’ll need to submit it again.

head to http://argonauts.musefacktory.com

connect wallet → my crew → claim my prints

this first claim window will be open for approximately 48 hours. here’s how it will work:

the window closes, and we begin processing this batch for printing. all prints will be double sided and signed.
once the prints are finished, we’ll do a final ownership check to verify that the tokens haven’t been sold or transferred.
Amanda will then order the shipping labels, permanently locking the claims on chain and updating each token’s metadata to show that its print has been claimed.

the claim window closing and your print claim becoming permanent are two separate steps.

if you sell or transfer an Argo before its shipping label is created, it will be removed from your order and its print status will return to unclaimed.

once that label is created, the claim is permanent. it cannot be undone, and that Argo’s print can never be claimed again, even if the token changes hands.

we’ll be printing in batches. this first batch starts now, with the next planned for spring 2027. we expect to continue offering batches over time, potentially for years, but we encourage everyone to claim the prints they want to keep now. if you have Argos you’re planning to sell, consider leaving their prints unclaimed for a future owner.

once we have the final claim count, we’ll share how many prints are in this first batch and a clearer timeline for when you can expect them.

there are a few steps on our end, but yours is simple: claim the Argos you want printed. the prints are free, and so is shipping.

thank you all for your patience 🫶
